Mallplaza Norte

One of the largest malls in Santiago, well connected by metro and with a full range of stores, dining and services for a day of shopping.

Best for

  • First day in Santiago
  • Families
  • Tourists without a car

Not ideal for

  • Those looking for premium or boutique brands

Getting there

Very well connected, near Dorsal station.

Recommended time: 2–4 hours

  • Cementerio General

Tips

  • Easy to combine with a visit to Patronato neighbourhood for wholesale clothing.
